concept.title: Volunteering as a sports coach
concept.shortdesc: As an active adult, I need to find opportunities to volunteer as a sports coach, so that I can give back and meet people.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-019). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Offers his own skills; the study keeps opportunities to give apart from services to receive.
A good result: Volunteer roles in sport with what is asked, training offered and how to apply.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: help run a youth sports club

section.title: How the draft did on this need
section.p: Model-judged, in four places, with no human check yet. See for how to read it.
